---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible defect in cl-observability-kit
title: "[bug] "
labels: ["bug"]
---

## Summary

Describe the failure in one or two sentences.

## Reproduction

List the smallest form, test file, or ASDF system that reproduces the issue.
Name which systems were loaded (`cl-observability-kit` and any of
`/prometheus`, `/otlp`, `/log-kit`).

## Expected Behavior

Describe the expected outcome.

## Actual Behavior

Describe the observed outcome, including the condition type and report text, or
the differing exposition/OTLP output.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results.

## Environment

Include the SBCL version, platform, and the cl-observability-kit tag or commit.
